peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 4% above its local comparables; 35 of 44 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Above peers (87.3): 6.1 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 44 of 51 similar developments (the same as 1). Context, not scored: resales in 95.8% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (RCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few resales by bedroom type for a like-for-like entry-price comparison; the size-matched price position applies.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Queenstown MRT about 80 m, Redhill MRT about 1,240 m; closer than 46 of 51 similar developments (the same as 2). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 4 within 2 km; nearest Queenstown Primary School about 150 m; more than 24 of 51 similar developments (the same as 23). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 6 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 320 m), more than 28 of 51 similar developments (the same as 7); nearest hawker centre Margaret Drive Hawker Centre about 440 m; nearest park Rail Corridor about 870 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 3 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Penrith, 457 new sales, about 260 m; Bloomsbury Residences, 123 new sales, about 1,320 m; Hudson Place Residences, 226 new sales, about 1,320 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 58 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 806 new sales and 549 resales (1,355 purchases); new sales were 59.5% of these purchases. Subsales (71) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 549 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 17 of 51 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 549 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 556 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−1.3%). Planning-area private resales −1.4%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
